chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated that al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Qurashi said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal, from Abi al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) who said: My father narrated to me, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The disease of the nations before you, animosity and jealousy, has crept upon you.
ai.seo_question: What are the two diseases of previous nations that have infiltrated Muslims according to Imam Ali (AS)?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of Imam al-Rida (s) to Imam Ali (as) and finally the Prophet (s), highlights the continuity of spiritual decay across prophetic histories. In Shia scholarship, 'al-baghda' (animosity/rivalry) and 'al-hasad' (jealousy/envy) are viewed as the root causes of societal fragmentation and the loss of divine unity, serving as a critical diagnostic for the moral health of the Ummah.
